third note of a major scale
An exclamation of sarcastic surprise (often doubled or tripled and in a lowering intonation).
Of or relating to the epoch before written record.

A service request, used to track complaints or requests that an issue be handled.
To begin building.
Having broad shoulders.
A state of motion affected by no acceleration or force other than that of gravity.
Possessions or equipment; stuff; gear.

A unit of measurement of angle equal to ¹⁄₃₆₀ of a circle's circumference.
A level of primary and secondary education.
The degree of something undesirable; badness or seriousness.
The state of being complicit; involvement as a partner or accomplice, especially in a crime or other wrongdoing.

Considering; taking into account.
Very small, diminutive
The strait connecting the Sea of Marmara with the Aegean Sea to the west.
One who travels to visit a site of religious significance.

Terminating in a point or edge, especially one that can cut or pierce easily; not dull, obtuse, or rounded.

(botany) Having a sharp and stiff point.

Having a sharp, pungent flavor.

Items or an item of clothing that is worn on the foot; a shoe, sandal, etc.
Red-headed bunting (Emberiza bruniceps).
The continent that is south of Europe, east of the Atlantic Ocean, west of the Indian Ocean and north of Antarctica.
Of or pertaining to Africa.
Having a value of; proper to be exchanged for.
A performance in public, for example in a drama, film, on a musical album, as a sports contestant etc.
The state of being a child.
The state or period of infancy.
Having great enthusiasm, passion and energy.
Creating or producing excitement.
Thrilled; excited.
Inducing suspense.
Causing irritation or inflammation.

A female tiger; a she-tiger.
Worthy to be remembered; very important or remarkable.
Never to be forgotten; that merits being always remembered.
Very difficult or impossible to forget.
(of a tune or phrase) Instantly appealing and memorable.
The part of a computer that is fixed and cannot be altered without replacement or physical modification; motherboard, expansion cards, etc.

(chiefly, _, British, often plural) A removable item in a house or other building, which can be taken with one when one moves out, such as a moveable piece of furniture, a carpet, picture, etc.; US furnishing; compare fixture.
The fashion in which something is organized or arranged.
The objects, other than furniture, that occupy an interior space.
(informal) The English language (spoken or written) as used in Canada; Canadian English.
The 86th sura (chapter) of the Qur'an.
A blood-sucking bat; vampire bat (Desmodus rotundus)
Any of several tropical Asian plants, of the genus Alocasia, having heart- or arrowhead-shaped leaves.
A measured portion of medicine taken at any one time.

Used to acknowledge a small mistake or accident.
Used to express sorrow, regret, compassion, grief, resignation, or disappointment.

An apparatus that slowly releases a liquid, especially one that intravenously releases drugs into a patient's bloodstream.
joint
buttocks
Each of the two large fleshy halves of the posterior part of the body between the base of the back, the perineum, and the top of the legs.
(anatomy) Relating to the buttocks.
(anatomy) The area encompassing the upper thigh, hip and buttocks on one side of a human, primate, or quadruped animal, especially one that can sit on its hindquarters.
bird from the Canary Islands
Any of various small finches in the genus Serinus, with largely yellow plumage.
Man-made; made by humans; of artifice.
An incongruous mixture.

The act of arranging.
The result of adjusting something; a small change; a minor correction; a modification or alteration.

A comment added to a text.
A sage.
domestic fowl
A fluid that dissolves a solid, liquid, or gaseous solute, resulting in a solution.

Any thick liquid that has a high sugar content and which is added to or poured over food as a flavoring.
Placed in a lower class, rank, or position.
path of one object around another
The path of a body as it travels through space.
To emphasise (a syllable of a word).

A main public road, especially a multi-lane, high-speed thoroughfare.

A highway with grade-separated crossings (rather than level crossings) and designed (and only permitted) for high-speed motor-traffic (in Europe motor vehicles with a higher speed limit than 40 km/h) running in two directions on one separate carriageway each.
(US) An expressway, especially one designed for high speeds.
The broken remains of an object, usually rock or masonry.
A form of musical notation indicating fingering rather than the pitch of notes, commonly used for stringed instruments.
The Greek philosopher, 427–347 BC, follower of Socrates.
Having a pale purple colour.

Any cocktail served in a cocktail glass, often sweet or fruity and aimed at women.
The largest island in the Mediterranean Sea, an autonomous region of Italy, close to Africa and separated from Tunisia and Libya by the Strait of Sicily.
To rest in a horizontal position on a surface.

An act or instance of purging.
Any of various seabirds of the family Pelecanidae, having a long bill with a distendable pouch.

The seed-like fruit of the caraway plant.

A message sent quickly, as a shipment, a prompt settlement of a business, or an important official message sent by a diplomat, government official, military officer, etc.

An exclamation used in songs of praise or thanksgiving to God.

(Roman god) The god of love, son of Venus; sometimes depicted as a putto (a naked, winged boy with bow and arrow). The Roman counterpart of Eros.
Very beautiful.
A town in the Nile delta in Egypt.
One who attends a wedding.
(Zoroastrianism) The hypostasis of chaos, destruction, evil.
A tentative conjecture explaining an observation, phenomenon or scientific problem and that can be tested by further observation, investigation, or experimentation.
The act of presuming, or something presumed.

Any salt or ester of glutamic acid.
Sexual activity with a person of the opposite sex.
The space in which a piston travels inside a reciprocating engine or pump.

In the International System of Units, the derived unit of energy, work and heat; the work required to exert a force of one newton for a distance of one metre. Equivalent to one watt-second (one watt of power acting for a duration of one second).
A soldier (especially a horseman) covered with a cataphract (etymology 1, sense 1).
An interruption to the regular flow or sequence of something.
The chemical element (symbol Xe) with an atomic number of 54. It is a colorless, odorless, unreactive noble gas, used notably in camera flash technology.
The act or process of Latinizing, of making Latin; including translating into Latin.
A waiter who has a supervisory position over the other wait staff; chief waiter.
